about.title: About Aloha Swimming Pools
text: For over 40 years, Aloha Swimming Pools Inc has proudly served the Greater Houston area as a trusted, locally-owned, and family-operated business. We’ve earned a strong reputation for quality craftsmanship, reliable service, and personalized care. Whether it’s weekly maintenance, equipment repairs, or complete pool renovations our experienced team understands the demands of Texas pool ownership and delivers results that last.
We proudly serve a wide service area encompassing various cities within the Greater Houston region.

Your satisfaction is our priority. Owner Brian personally supervises each project to guarantee customer satisfaction. As an accredited business with the BBB, Aloha Swimming Pools maintains a stellar reputation with zero complaints. Rest assured, our team comprises trustworthy individuals with extensive experience, including military veterans and hometown heroes.
